scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace server & npm run dev --workspace web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.start: node scripts/ensure-native.mjs && npm run start --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.demo: node scripts/ensure-native.mjs && npm run build && npm run demo --workspace server
scripts.demo:reset: node scripts/ensure-native.mjs && npm run build && npm run demo:reset --workspace server
scripts.update: git checkout -- package-lock.json && git pull --ff-only && npm ci && node scripts/ensure-native.mjs
